text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Energy refurbishment costs a lot of money, takes a long time, and the complicated services technology confuses building owners.", "gist": "Energy refurbishment is expensive, time-consuming, and confusing for building owners."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "St. Gallen", "gist": "City in Switzerland"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Mettiss AG", "gist": "St. Gallen property company"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In St. Gallen there is a newly refurbished office building from the sixties which dispels such thoughts completely.", "gist": "A refurbished 1960s office building in St. Gallen disproves the negative perceptions of energy refurbishment."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Kegel’s Rule", "gist": "Beat Kegel’s energy concept"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "was implemented in cooperation with the St. Gallen property company Mettiss AG", "gist": "Beat Kegel’s energy concept was implemented in partnership with Mettiss AG"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The refurbishment was realised rapidly and cost-effectively and the building now easily meets the passive house standard.", "gist": "The refurbishment was fast, affordable, and achieved passive house standard"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "This is due to a cost-effective low-technology heating and ventilation system incorporated in prefabricated parapet elements and connector fans in the doors.", "gist": "The success was achieved using a low-tech heating and ventilation system in prefabricated parts and door fans."}]}
